meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Oily skin ke liye **₹500 ke andar meri top recommendation Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Wash (100 ml)** hai—लगभग ₹299, fragrance-free, aur oil, blackheads aur clogged pores ke liye useful hai.[2][5]

### Skin concern ke hisaab se options

- **Oily + acne/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA — करीब ₹278–299.[2]
- **Sensitive oily skin:** Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Face Wash — करीब ₹224–450; ya **Minimalist Gentle Gel Face Wash**.[1][7][8]
- **Budget daily cleanser:** Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash — करीब ₹120–250.[1][5]
- **Oily + dull skin:** Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash — करीब ₹239–349.[5][7]
- **Stronger acne/oil control:** The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash — करीब ₹263–449.[2][5]

**Kaise use karein:** Salicylic-acid face wash se shuruat mein sirf raat ko, week mein 3–4 baar use karein; irritation na ho to daily kar sakte hain. Face wash ke baad lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturiser aur din mein sunscreen lagayein. Over-washing na karein—din mein maximum do baar.[2]

Agar pimples nahi hain aur sirf oiliness hai, to **Simple Refreshing Face Wash**; agar acne/blackheads bhi hain, to **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** kharidna behtar rahega.
